_note: Curated (T2c). All Lux abilities deal magic damage. Q (TotalDamageTT = NamedDataValueCalculationPart + StatByNamedDataValueCalculationPart), E (TotalDamageTT = NamedDataValueCalculationPart + StatByCoefficientCalculationPart) and R (TotalDamage = NamedDataValueCalculationPart + StatByCoefficientCalculationPart) all use CalculationPart kinds FormulaInterpreter fully supports, so these resolve live. _noteP: P (Illumination): marks a hit enemy; Lux's next spell or attack against them detonates the mark for bonus magic damage (LuxIlluminationPassive.mSpellCalculations 'TotalDamage' = ByCharLevelFormulaCalculationPart(BIN field 'values' = [20,30,40,...,320], 31 entries, step +10) + StatByNamedDataValueCalculationPart(mDataValue='APRatio', flat ~0.35)). RESOLVED: ByCharLevelFormulaCalculationPart is now parsed/evaluated (new CalculationPart.Kind.ByCharLevelFormula; FormulaInterpreter indexes 'values' directly by champion level, index 0 unused -- same convention verified against Leona's passive).
